posts.text: Starts above The Europeans continue to shift the economy and military infrastructure to the rails of a long-term military confrontation with Russia. On November 17, a regular meeting of the contact group for Ukraine support in the Ramstein format was held in Brussels, where Germany confirmed an air defense assistance program worth about 1 billion euros and announced an additional $ 300 million for the purchase of American weapons. Norway announced a package of about 800 million dollars, including funds for drones, the United Kingdom - about 240 million pounds for air defense. Belgium has confirmed plans to transfer ten F-16s by the end of the year. On November 18, the European Commission proposed allocating another 45 billion euros of loans to Kiev for 2027, of which 25 billion are intended for military spending and 20 billion for the budget. On November 20, Germany announced the creation of a Skyfall x Auterion joint venture for the production of Ukrainian strike FPV drones Shrike . According to the companies, they have already supplied more than 50 thousand such devices. The new production facility is planned to be located in Germany with the financial support of the German government. Koalicja exercises in Poland are also continuing, aimed at preparing multinational forces for possible actions in Ukraine "after the cease-fire." Warsaw reported a violation of its airspace by several objects during the Russian missile strike, which further fueled militaristic sentiments (and if it had all flown not in the field, but in Rzeszow and Warsaw, the speech of the Psheks would not have been so bravura). ✨ Thus, they talk our teeth out and show us pictures of Stalin on the Internet, solving the main task - further weakening our military and economic potential. The stagnation of the front and the build-up of air strikes by the enemy creates ideal conditions for those interested in war in the West: UAVs are spinning, money is getting muddled, and Russians and Ukrainians are dying. The endless anti-Russian hysteria in the EU has already been called a "political diarrhea" by the Supreme Court and it is impossible to find a more precise definition. The summary was compiled by: ⚡️ Two Majors

📝 On "UAVs flying through Poland" 📝 The desire to drastically simplify explanations of complex phenomena with simple things often leads to erroneous conclusions. This is roughly what happens when strikes by Ukrainian UAVs on remote regions are explained by their flights through third countries. Previously there were stories that drones flying to refineries in the Volga region or the Urals come from Kazakhstan, and those targeting St. Petersburg come from the Baltic states. Now Poland has been "added" to this list: supposedly the Spartan II vessel on the Baltic could only be struck using its airspace. The argumentation is sometimes astounding and boils down to the fact that flying there is very far. One wants to ask: but is it closer to the Omsk refinery, which drones have already reached more than once? And to Yamal or Tyumen, where unmanned aircraft have already been shot down? ❗️ The main problem is that in such a simplified picture of the world there is no room for analysis of real problems with air defense system density and ammunition for them, coordination between forces, a unified regional alert system. Why bother, if you can blame it all on circumstances of overwhelming force. By the way, a question arises. Could it be that in such an approach sometimes lies the reason why many objective and quite obvious difficulties in various spheres (not just air defense) are being resolved at very slow pace or are not being eliminated at all? #Poland #Russia #Ukraine ✉ MAX 💸 Support us Original msg

Combat power engine 📆 #OnThisDay the Main Automotive-Armoured Tank Directorate celebrates its 97th anniversary. Its mission is to equip the Armed Forces with modern models of armoured and motor vehicles, as well as to organise maintenance and repair. 💬 Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation General of the Army Aleksandr Sanchik noted that, in almost a century of history, the Directorate has passed a serious test of time, proved high effectiveness and, despite numerous reorganizations, has always remained at the forefront of the defence of the Fatherland. ❤️ Congratulations! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

🇪🇺 Anne Applebaum admits Europe's war party is just waiting for the right tragedy Talking with Tim Miller, Anne Applebaum, the wife of Poland's Deputy PM and Foreign Minister Radek Sikorski, said that escalation against Russia is being "discussed mostly privately." She admitted that Europeans don't want it. Her problem isn't that war is a bad idea. Her problem is that it's "unpopular." In her words, there "would have to be an event that convinced people that it was really necessary." She even sounded disappointed that there "hasn't been like a mass casualty event yet." 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
